title: 第1章 血脉族谱第2章 每日一卦
content_zh:
;;
洞溪村。
村头小道，许川头戴草帽，身穿粗麻背心，挽着裤脚，肩上扛着一把锄头，手里拎着用秸秆绑着的两条大青鱼往村子里走去。
晚霞的余晖将他影子拉得长长的，古铜色的皮肤熠熠生辉。
“三竖，回家了。”
前方大槐树下，一位两鬓微白的老汉，手里拿着一把蒲扇轻轻扇动。
看到许川后，亲热地打着招呼。
见他手里的大青鱼，老汉微微一笑，“今日收获不错啊。”
“陈伯，又在乘凉呐。”
“还不是贼老天捉弄的，这么热的天，也就你这身子骨能在毒日下坚持这么久了。”
许川咧嘴一笑。
他身高一米八几，身材匀称，在洞溪村一众男人间也不算魁梧，甚至可以说在其他人眼里有些瘦弱。
但许川从小到大都没生过病。
村里都说许川是个有福气的，受到老天爷厚爱。
其实不然。
许川是一名穿越者。
是有点天赋在身上的。
他出生在一户普通黎庶家里，他爹许平是洞溪村大户徐家的长工。
三岁懵懂时，他娘去世。
十五岁时，许平也因为过度辛劳走了。

有前世宿慧，许川学东西很快，在农事上是一把好手。
徐家也十分看重他，在他爹走后，为了留住他，给涨了两倍的工钱。
但许川还是毅然辞了徐家的活计。
用近乎全部的积蓄买了十亩稻田。
村里人都说许川目光短浅，徐家在十里八乡都是有名的大户，想要成为他们家的长工可不容易。
许平在徐家干了一辈子，最开始许川也是因为自己老爹才能在徐家当长工。
如今却白白辞了，给别人让位。
但许川可不这么认为。
给别人打工怎么可能比得上给自己打工来得有拼劲。
当然，也是觉得低调发育了十五年，也到了自立门户的时候。
作为穿越者，许川伴生一本【血脉族谱】，不过现在的族谱只有一页，第一页上也仅有许川一个名字。
想要上族谱，必须滴血在上面，才会显现名字。
许川也是在六岁时，误打误撞试出来的，还是一个【三无青年】
【许川：许家一代】
【灵根：五行不全，无修仙资质】
【天赋：无】
【血脉：无】
之后【血脉族谱】诞生了三项天赋，分别是【龙精虎猛】、【每日一卦】和【天道酬勤】。
都用在了自己身上。
【龙精虎猛】让他日日精力充沛，气血旺盛。

自然无病无灾。
content_en:
;;
Cave Creek Village.
On the trail at the end of the village, Xu Chuan was walking towards the village wearing a straw hat, a hemp vest, his trousers rolled up, a hoe on his shoulder, and two big herrings tied with straw in his hand.
The afterglow of the sunset stretched his shadow long, and his bronze skin shone.
"Sanju, go home."
Under the big locust tree in front, an old man with slightly white temples was holding a cattail leaf fan and fanning it gently.
After seeing Xu Chuan, he greeted him affectionately.
Seeing the big herring in his hand, the old man smiled slightly and said, "The harvest is good today."
"Uncle Chen, you are enjoying the cool air again."
"It's not God's trick. It's such a hot day. Only your bones can survive the poisonous sun for so long."
Xu Chuan grinned.
He is over 1.8 meters tall and has a well-proportioned figure. Among the men in Dongxi Village, he is not considered burly. It can even be said that he is a bit thin in the eyes of others.
But Xu Chuan has never been sick since he was a child.
Everyone in the village said that Xu Chuan was blessed and loved by God.
Not really.
Xu Chuan is a time traveler.
He has some talent in him.
He was born in an ordinary Li family, and his father Xu Ping was a long-time employee of the Xu family, a large family in Dongxi Village.
When he was three years old, his mother died.
At the age of fifteen, Xu Ping also passed away due to excessive hard work.
With Su Hui in his previous life, Xu Chuan learned things quickly and was a good hand in farming.
The Xu family also valued him very much. After his father left, in order to keep him, they doubled his salary.
But Xu Chuan still resolutely quit working in the Xu family.
I used almost all my savings to buy ten acres of rice fields.
People in the village said that Xu Chuan was short-sighted. The Xu family was a well-known big family in all the towns and villages. It was not easy to become a long-term employee of their family.
Xu Ping has worked in the Xu family all his life. In the beginning, Xu Chuan was able to work in the Xu family because of his father.
Now he has resigned in vain and made way for others.
But Xu Chuan doesn't think so.
How can working for others be as hard as working for yourself?
Of course, I also felt that after fifteen years of low-key development, it was time to set up my own business.
As a time traveler, Xu Chuan brought along a "Bloodline Genealogy", but the current genealogy only has one page, and there is only Xu Chuan's name on the first page.
If you want to be on the family tree, you have to drop blood on it, and then the name will appear.
Xu Chuan was also born by mistake when he was six years old. He was still a [Three No Youth]
[Xuchuan: The First Generation of the Xu Family]
[Spiritual Root: Incomplete Five Elements, No Qualification for Immortal Cultivation]
[Talent: None]
[Bloodline: None]
After that, three talents were born in [Bloodline Genealogy], namely [Dragon Spirit and Tiger Fierceness], [Daily Hexagram] and [Heaven Rewards Divination].
They all used it on themselves.
【Dragon Spirit and Tiger Fierce】make him energetic and strong every day.
Naturally, there is no disease or disaster.
